metadata.description: Generic Claude Code plugins for AI engineering workflows. Sole plugin since v4.0.0: learn-kit — pedagogical kit. v6.1.0 minor bump alongside learn-kit 3.1.0 — additive HITL expansion: Step 1.3 视角 multi-select (foundation / structural / challenge; default all 3, min 1) + Step 4 5-cell granular artifact-type multi-select (HTML / NLM audio / NLM video / NLM slide_deck / NLM mind_map; default all unchecked); Step 5B re-run guard adds source_corpus_key equivalence check; 3-level hint granularity (explicit-type / generic-NLM / no-hint); adaptive Quota gate. Default product output preserved from v6.0.0 (defaults reproduce 3-tier markdown + no extras). v6.0.0 BREAKING baseline: learn-kit consolidates from 5 skills (scaffold-learning / locate / scan / generate-tier / nlm-studio) into single `three-views` skill that generates 1-3 tier learning markdown from sources (project files / external URL via WebFetch / pasted text via source_manifest tracking), then optionally renders interactive HTML (dual-mode grounding: repo-code via Explore subagent or source-evidence) and/or pushes to NotebookLM for max 10 multimedia artifacts (audio/video/slide_deck × 3 views = 9 + 1 shared mind_map; infographic permanently retired). Preserves all nlm-studio dogfood防护 (per-step auth refresh / source validation / 4-way re-run guard / quota right-sizing gate / bounded polling). See [ADR]_LearnKit_ThreeViews_HITL_Expansion.md (v3.1.0) + [ADR]_LearnKit_Consolidation_To_Single_Skill.md (v3.0.0) + Migration_From_v3_to_v4 §6 for full walkthrough. v4.1.0 adds 19 project-local mp-* workflow skills under .claude/skills/. v4.2.0+ introduces marketplace documentation framework (currently v1.6).

plugins.name: learn-kit
plugins.description: Pedagogical kit. Single skill `three-views`: given a topic + source material (project files / external URL / pasted text), generates a user-chosen subset of 1-3 tier learning markdown (foundation 零基础版 / structural 结构版 / challenge 挑战版). v3.1.0 additive HITL expansion: Step 1.3 视角 multi-select (default all 3 checked, min 1) lets users pick subset; Step 4 5-cell granular multi-select (HTML / NLM audio / NLM video / NLM slide_deck / NLM mind_map; default all unchecked) replaces v3.0.0 3-coarse-cell layout. NLM cartesian = len(generated_tiers) × len(selected view-cycled types) + (1 if mind_map); max 10 when full defaults. v3.1.0 Step 5B re-run guard adds source_corpus_key equivalence check (prevents partial-rerun corpus contamination). Backward-compatible: defaults preserve v3.0.0 product output. HTML uses dual-mode grounding (concept→code via Explore for project file sources; concept→source-section for URL/text). NLM preserves all nlm-studio dogfood防护: per-step refresh_auth, real auth gate via notebook_list, source_add validation via notebook_get, 4-way re-run guard, quota right-sizing 4-way gate (3-way when degenerate), bounded polling 12×10s. Requires notebooklm-mcp MCP server (bundled) + one-time `nlm login` only when NLM opt-in is selected. Slash: `/learn-kit:three-views <topic>` (auto-discovered). v3.0.0 baseline BREAKING: removed 4 skills (scaffold-learning, locate, scan, nlm-studio); renamed generate-tier → three-views. locate/scan algorithms preserved as manual recipes in plugin-internal [GUIDE]_LearnKit_Discovery_Recipes.md.
